continuum: continuum_two_pole.py c2c73cb4 (h=5e-4 used; h=1e-3 grid check at each R)

scan.wrad_check: wrad=10000 at N=61 for each theta and n; dE_rel reported (limit 0.005 as in recheck)

gap: sup over geodesic r<=3 (rho=1) of each pole of |b_sym-b_cont|/max|b_cont|, b=coherent-state symbol of B vs continuum (1-e^u)/2 at same R

F2_E.i: per theta,n: gap(N)=g_inf+c/N least squares (3 pts, 1 dof), g_inf>0 and g_inf>3*SE
F2_E.ii: g_inf increasing in theta and log-log fit g_inf=A theta^p gives p>0, per n (pole-averaged gap)
F2_E.FAIL: g_inf consistent with 0 (<=3SE) at all theta
F2_E.UNDECIDED: unstable fits or plateau at only some theta

reported_only.core_size: geodesic r where b_sym drops to 1/4 (half of core value 1/2) from the pole, vs max(1,sqrt(theta))

prediction: genuinely uncertain; no numeric guess frozen beyond the criteria
